A '''governor''' of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] was stationed on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Pesmenben IV]].<ref name="ROTJ" /> By [[0 BBY/Legends|0 BBY]],<ref name="Date">''[[The New Essential Guide to Characters]]'' establishes that [[Lando Calrissian/Legends|Lando Calrissian's]] scheme on [[Pesmenben IV]] occurred prior to the [[Battle of Ylesia]], which ''[[The New Essential Chronology]]'' dates to [[0 BBY/Legends|0 BBY]].</ref> the [[Human/Legends|Human]] businessman [[Lando Calrissian/Legends|Lando Calrissian]] conned the [[Governor/Legends|governor]] into leasing the planet by salting its dunes with [[lithium carbonate]]; posing as a non-union [[Mining/Legends|mine]] [[Security guard/Legends|guard]], he made the governor lie facedown in the bottom of a [[Boat/Legends|boat]] so that when the "union officials" raided them, the governor threw the bribe overboard. Calrissian got away with the scam without punishment.<ref name="ROTJ" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Imperial governor was first mentioned in [[James Kahn]]'s [[1983]] [[Star Wars: Return of the Jedi (novelization)|novelization]] of the [[original trilogy]] film [[Star Wars: Episode VI Return of the Jedi|''Star Wars'': Episode VI ''Return of the Jedi'']].<ref name="ROTJ" />
